title: Concept Checking Question (CCQ)
description: Schema for Concept Checking Questions. The ccq field must be answerable yes/no or with a short factual answer, and must never ask the learner to translate.

targetItem.description: The word, phrase, or target grammar/vocabulary structure being checked.

language.description: The ISO language code or language name for the target item.

ccq.description: The concept checking question. Must be answerable yes/no or with a short factual answer, and must never ask the learner to translate.

answer.description: The expected answer (e.g. 'Yes', 'No', or a short factual response).

distractor.description: An optional incorrect or distractor response for multiple-choice checks.
